about: For each source file: the level that introduced it (1, 2 or 3), the later levels that changed it, and its one responsibility. tests/architecture.test.ts checks this file. The course page reads it.

shared/dates.ts.role: A check that text is a real calendar date. It imports nothing.

shared/money.ts.role: Money as integer cents: text to cents, cents to text, a percentage of an amount.

shared/contracts.ts.role: The data contracts of the web application and the server, and the check of shape.

shared/contracts.test.ts.role: Proves each rule of shape with a FAIL case.

server/main.ts.role: Composition root: makes all the parts and connects them.

server/config.ts.role: Reads the settings from the environment.

server/clock.ts.role: Ports for time and identifiers, with fixed versions for tests.

server/errors.ts.role: The expected errors and the status code of each.

server/domain/expense.ts.role: The expense as pure functions: proposal, merchant key, month.

server/domain/budget.ts.role: The state of a budget from a limit and a spent amount.

server/domain/budget.test.ts.role: Proves the four budget states and the month edges.

server/domain/expense-rules.ts.role: The business rules R5 to R7 as one pure function.

server/domain/expense-rules.test.ts.role: Proves each business rule with PASS and FAIL.

server/repositories/ports.ts.role: The ports of the stores: expenses, categories, budgets, the plan and the income.

server/repositories/memory.ts.role: The stores in memory, for tests.

server/repositories/sqlite.ts.role: The stores in SQLite. The only SQL of the three tables.

server/repositories/migrate.ts.role: Applies the numbered schema files, forward only.

server/repositories/contract.test.ts.role: One suite that the two store implementations must pass.

server/repositories/sqlite-file.test.ts.role: Proves that data stays in a file, and that the database refuses bad data.

server/services/record-expense.ts.role: The use case 'record an expense'. From level 2: a thin facade that runs the graph.

server/services/record-expense.test.ts.role: Says what 'record an expense' means, in nine cases.

server/services/month-summary.ts.role: The use case: show one month. It only reads.

server/http/handlers.ts.role: One small function for each operation of the API.

server/http/server.ts.role: HTTP: finds the handler, reads JSON, protects the server, maps errors.

server/http/api.test.ts.role: The whole server through real HTTP requests.

web/src/App.tsx.role: Owns the screen state and calls the server.

web/src/api.ts.role: The only file of the web application that calls fetch.

web/src/state.ts.role: The screen state and its pure reducer.

web/src/state.test.ts.role: Proves that a retry keeps the request key.

web/src/ExpenseForm.tsx.role: The form. Shows state, sends actions.

web/src/BudgetPanel.tsx.role: Shows the budgets and the last expenses.

tests/architecture.test.ts.role: Checks the boundaries between the folders and the levels.

shared/ontology.ts.role: The classes, relations, permitted values and rules R1 to R11, as data.

server/graph/engine.ts.role: The interpreter of an execution graph. Enforces the state contract.

server/graph/engine.test.ts.role: Proves the state contract, the edge order and the step budget.

server/graph/state.ts.role: The typed state of the record graph and the owner of each field.

server/graph/verifier.ts.role: Reads the ledger again with its own queries and compares.

server/graph/verifier.test.ts.role: Breaks the ledger in five ways; the verifier must give FAIL.

server/graph/trace.ts.role: The trace of each run with checkpoints: the context graph.

server/graph/trace.test.ts.role: Proves the trace on two stores, and that it never fails an expense.

server/graph/record-expense.graph.ts.role: The execution graph: eleven nodes, their edges, three ends.

server/graph/record-expense.paths.test.t.role: For each scenario: status, exact path, rows in the ledger.

scripts/scenarios.ts.role: The scenario type, the scenarios of the record graph and the suggest graph, the list of all scenarios, and the function that runs one.

scripts/record-runs.ts.role: Records each scenario from the real code for the course page, with the allowlist, the gate rules and the plan example.

scripts/recordings.test.ts.role: Proves that the recordings are current and repeatable.

shared/contracts.suggest.ts.role: The contract of "suggest a category": the request, the reasons, the response.

server/intelligence/suggester.ts.role: The port of the model: what it gets and what it can give back.

server/intelligence/fake-suggester.ts.role: A predictable stand-in for the model, for tests and recordings.

server/intelligence/claude-suggester.ts.role: The real model: one Claude API call with a structured output. One of the two files that import the SDK; the other is the interpreter of the assist path.

server/intelligence/prompts/suggest-cate.role: The prompt, as a file that a person can read and change.

server/intelligence/suggestion-gate.ts.role: Checks a suggestion against the permitted categories (R12).

server/intelligence/merchant-memory.ts.role: What the person confirmed for each merchant. Asked before the model.

server/intelligence/suggest-category.gra.role: The suggest graph: memory, cost control, model, gate. It cannot write the ledger.

server/intelligence/suggest-category.pat.role: Paths of the suggest graph; a suggestion never writes; the learning loop.

server/intelligence/intelligence.test.ts.role: The gate, the memory and the adapter of the real model, each alone.

tests/ai-off.test.ts.role: Runs level 2 again with no model, a slow model and a broken model.

shared/contracts.import.ts.role: The contracts of an import: the rows of the proposal, the mapping step, the five ends, the answers.

server/import/pool.ts.role: Runs work for many items, a limited number at the same time.

server/import/line-worker.ts.role: The workers: one suggest sub-run, one record sub-run or one income row. And the store of checkpoints.

server/import/reconciler.ts.role: The independent check of an import: each line has exactly one end, and the ledger agrees (R14).

server/import/import.graph.ts.role: The orchestrator graph: its edges, and the three steps (propose, give a mapping, decide) with a resume.

server/import/import-state.ts.role: The typed state of the import graph with its owners, the ports of the orchestrator, and the keys.

server/import/import-nodes.read.ts.role: The nodes that read and propose: inspect, map, await_mapping, stage, classify.

server/import/import-nodes.write.ts.role: The nodes that act after the decisions: await_person, apply, reconcile, export, respond, reject.

server/import/ledger-view.ts.role: What an import reads from the ledger: known keys, rows of other accounts, entries for the export.

server/import/import.test.ts.role: Pool, reconciler by sabotage, and the whole import with the sample files: mapping, pairs, duplicates, export.

server/repositories/migrations/006_impor.role: Table: import_batches again, with the state "waits for a mapping".

web/src/ImportReview.tsx.role: The review screen of an import: the account, the rows with their status, the decision of each line.

web/src/ImportOutcome.tsx.role: The result of an import with the export text to copy, and the form for a mapping.

server/intelligence/model-budget.ts.role: The model calls of one day. A call is reserved before it is made.

tests/review-fixes.test.ts.role: One test for each defect that the adversarial review found.

shared/planning/pay-cycle.ts.role: The pay cycle: from payday to the day before the next payday, and its 7-day blocks.

shared/planning/pay-cycle.test.ts.role: Proves the pay cycle at month ends, year ends and the limits of the payday.

shared/planning/plan-types.ts.role: The types of the payday plan: the input, the lines, the moves, the plan.

shared/planning/plan-check.ts.role: The check of the plan input: a wrong number is a problem, not a plan.

shared/planning/plan-check.test.ts.role: Proves that a plan input with a wrong number is refused.

shared/planning/plan-sizing.ts.role: How much the person can save (the worst complete cycle) and which pot gets it.

shared/planning/plan-moves.ts.role: The moves of the day after payday in a fixed order, and the weekly caps.

shared/planning/plan.ts.role: buildPlan: one pure function from the plan input to the payday plan.

shared/planning/plan.test.ts.role: Proves each line of the worked example, and the sizing.

shared/planning/plan-edges.test.ts.role: Proves the priority split, the order of the moves and the warnings.

shared/planning/plan-example.ts.role: The worked example of the payday plan: one fictional pay cycle.

shared/planning/pace.ts.role: The status of each week against its cap, and if the savings really moved.

shared/planning/pace.test.ts.role: Proves the week status at its boundaries and the savings rule.

shared/planning/insights.ts.role: Insights from the data of a cycle: observation, possible causes, an option.

shared/planning/insights.test.ts.role: Proves each detector with data that supports it and data that does not.

shared/planning/insights-edges.test.ts.role: Proves the insights for a cycle in progress, refunds and unsafe keys.

shared/pipeline/index.ts.role: runPipeline: raw text to staged rows through five deterministic stages.

shared/pipeline/index.test.ts.role: Proves the whole pipeline on the three sample files.

shared/pipeline/inspect.ts.role: Stage 1: raw text to a header and rows of cells.

shared/pipeline/inspect.test.ts.role: Proves the delimiter, the quoting and the problems of the inspect stage.

shared/pipeline/profiles.ts.role: Stages 2 and 3: the mapping profiles of two fictional banks, and the gate for any mapping.

shared/pipeline/profiles.test.ts.role: Proves the profile match and the mapping gate.

shared/pipeline/mapping-shape.ts.role: The shape check of a mapping at run time. It never throws.

shared/pipeline/values.ts.role: The readers of one date and one amount, shared by the gate and the normalise stage.

shared/pipeline/clean.ts.role: The clean description of a row, with only a safe part of the expression language.

shared/pipeline/normalise.ts.role: Stage 4: rows of cells to staged rows with provenance and a fingerprint.

shared/pipeline/normalise.test.ts.role: Proves dates, cents, directions and provenance of the normalise stage.

shared/pipeline/reconcile.ts.role: Stage 5: each staged row gets a status; only a new row is a candidate for the ledger.

shared/pipeline/reconcile.test.ts.role: Proves each status of the reconcile stage.

shared/pipeline/transfers.ts.role: The transfer rule: a move between two own accounts, matched by amount and date.

shared/pipeline/balance.ts.role: The balance check of a batch that has a running balance.

shared/pipeline/samples.ts.role: Three synthetic sample files of two fictional banks.

shared/pipeline/review-gate.test.ts.role: Review repairs: the mapping gate gives problems for any value.

shared/pipeline/review-rows.test.ts.role: Review repairs: a wrong amount or direction is never staged as new.

shared/export/paste-rows.ts.role: Ledger entries to tab-separated rows that a person pastes into a budget sheet.

shared/export/paste-rows.test.ts.role: Proves the columns, the notes and the safe cells of the export.

server/intelligence/permitted/capabiliti.role: The allowlist: the complete list of what a model is permitted to request (R15).
Fixes the allowlist: a new capability needs a change that a person reviews.

server/intelligence/permitted/inputs.ts.role: The input of each capability as a strict Zod schema.

server/intelligence/permitted/inputs.tes.role: Proves the input schemas and that the allowlist is frozen.

server/intelligence/permitted/action-gat.role: The action gate: four checks of each request of a model; the first FAIL stops it.
The gate check by check, with the audit record of each case.

server/intelligence/permitted/gate-findi.role: Review repairs of the gate: untrusted check answers, frozen results, clean texts.

server/intelligence/permitted/verify.ts.role: Check 4 of the gate: the application verifies the input against its own facts (R16).

server/intelligence/permitted/audit.ts.role: The short audit record of one request at the gate, and the helpers for safe text.

server/intelligence/permitted/execute.ts.role: The last step: only the application executes (R18), and a change waits for the person (R17).

server/intelligence/permitted/execute.te.role: Proves that only a PROPOSED result executes and a change waits for the person.

server/intelligence/permitted/execute-fi.role: Review repairs of execute: the input is checked again and runs one time.

server/intelligence/permitted/interprete.role: The port of the model that reads a request of the person in plain words.
The stand-in interpreter and the adapter of the real model with a stand-in client.

server/intelligence/permitted/fake-inter.role: A predictable stand-in for the interpreter, for tests and recordings.

server/intelligence/permitted/fake-findi.role: Review repairs of the stand-in interpreter.

server/intelligence/permitted/claude-int.role: The adapter of the real model for the interpreter port: one call through the SDK.

server/intelligence/permitted/adapter-fi.role: Review repairs of the adapter of the real model, with a stand-in client.

server/intelligence/permitted/flat-answe.role: The flat answer of the real model, and its change into a value of the port.

server/intelligence/permitted/prompts/in.role: The system prompt of the interpreter.

shared/contracts.plan.ts.role: The contracts of planning: settings, commitments, pots, income, and the plan view.

server/repositories/migrations/005_plann.role: Columns for the kind and class of a category and the account of an expense; tables: income, commitments, savings_pots, plan_settings.

server/repositories/memory-plan.ts.role: The plan store and the income store in memory.

server/repositories/sqlite-plan.ts.role: The plan store and the income store in SQLite.

server/repositories/plan-contract.test.t.role: One suite for the plan, income and listBetween stores, on memory and on SQLite.

server/services/plan-cycle.ts.role: The use case "show the plan of one pay cycle": each figure is calculated from stored rows.

server/services/plan-ledger.ts.role: Reads the ledger for the plan: the income of a cycle, the history of earlier cycles, the totals of this cycle.

server/services/plan-cycle.test.ts.role: The plan service with the stores in memory: the worked example, the history, the weeks, the headline.

shared/contracts.assist.ts.role: The contract of the assist path: the request, each status of the answer, the proposal, the decision, the audit record.

server/repositories/assist-store.ts.role: The store of the audit records and the proposals of the assist path: the port, memory and SQLite.

server/repositories/assist-contract.test.role: One suite for the store of the assist path, on memory and on SQLite.

server/services/assist.ts.role: The use case "read a request in plain words": the model recommends, the gate validates, a change becomes a stored proposal.

server/services/assist-checks.ts.role: The real Checks of the action gate: categories, import batches, the dry run of a mapping, the consequences of an allowance change (BR4).

server/services/assist-executors.ts.role: The executors of the assist path: services of the application, one for each capability (R18).

server/services/assist-decide.ts.role: The decision of the person for one proposal: decline, or the gate again and then execute, one time (R17).

server/services/assist.test.ts.role: The assist path with the stand-in interpreter: each status, the approval, and a ledger that stays the same.

server/http/assist-api.test.ts.role: POST /api/assist and the decide endpoint through HTTP, for the four capabilities.

scripts/world.ts.role: The world of a scenario: the real application with SQLite in memory, a fixed clock, stand-in models and a real HTTP server.

scripts/scenarios.import.ts.role: The scenarios of the import graph: two banks, the same file two times, an unknown layout, a mapping that fails.

scripts/scenarios.assist.ts.role: The scenarios of the assist path (each end of the permitted path) and of the plan of the worked example.

scripts/scenarios.test.ts.role: For each import, assist and plan scenario: status, path, answer, rows; and the shape of the recording.

tests/hardening.test.ts.role: One test for each defect that the final hardening pass repaired.
